title: "Policeman Sees Flying Saucer" - Tacoma newspaper clipping, Thursday, June 3, 1954
description: Newspaper clipping headlined "Policeman Sees Flying Saucer" mounted below a dateline strip reading "THURSDAY, JUNE 3, 1954." It reports that three Tacoma policemen have now seen flying saucers, the latest while driving from Doty toward Chehalis, describing an object that traveled northward at terrific speed, stopped motionless, then sped eastward; it also recalls a July 7, 1947 sighting by prowl car officers near The Narrows. The page bears FBI Seattle file number 100-18945-57 and a June 1954 indexing stamp.
